tasks.title: Gantry web console brand mark
tasks.objective: Replace the temporary boxed G badges and browser icon with the approved Gantry mark so auth, navigation, favicon, and touch-icon surfaces share one static browser identity.
acceptance_criteria: Auth pages use a 28px bronze #C0985F canonical mark beside the existing uppercase GANTRY wordmark, with no bordered G badge.
The sidebar uses a 24px --ink canonical mark beside the existing Gantry label and remains legible in both themes.
Browser icons use a dark #1B1A18 tile with an off-white #F7F6F4 mark: an SVG favicon and one 180 by 180 touch icon served under /ui/.
Existing auth copy, routes, navigation labels, page title, layout, and Google sign-in treatment do not change.
No PWA manifest, unused icon sizes, external image request, duplicate wordmark image, new dependency, API, schema, persistence, configuration, or runtime behavior is added.
